<!--
  Open jobs as cards in two columns, grouped by department, or as a table: the title, the department, the place,
  the type, an optional salary and an apply link. Axes: layout (grid, grouped, table), salary (show, hide),
  tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Job, Department, JobLabels } from "./job-board.types";

  export type JobBoardProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    jobs: Job[];
    departments: Department[];
    labels: JobLabels;
    layout?: "grid" | "grouped" | "table";
    salary?: "show" | "hide";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import JobCards from "../components/job-cards.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    jobs,
    departments,
    labels,
    layout = "grid",
    salary = "hide",
    tone = "default",
  }: JobBoardProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  lead={lead}
  tone={tone}
  density="default"
  measure={(((layout as string) === "grouped") ? "3xl" : "default")}
>
  {#if ((layout as string) === "grouped")}
    <Stack gap="8" align="stretch" data-testid="groups">
      {#each departments as d (d.id)}
        <Stack gap="2" align="stretch" data-testid="group">
          <Group gap="4" align="baseline" justify="between">
            <Title as={3} size="lg" weight="bold">
              {d.name}
            </Title>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {tpl(labels.count, (jobs.filter((i) => !d.id || i["dept"] === d.id)?.length ?? 0))}
            </Text>
          </Group>
          <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col">
            {#each jobs.filter((i) => !d.id || i["dept"] === d.id) as j (j.id)}
              <ListItem
                class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-border py-4"
                data-testid="item"
              >
                <Stack gap="0">
                  <Link href="#/careers" variant="default" class="font-medium">
                    {j.title}
                  </Link>
                  <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                    {tpl("{0}, {1}", j.location, j.type)}
                  </Text>
                </Stack>
                <Badge variant="outline" size="default">
                  {j.type}
                </Badge>
              </ListItem>
            {/each}
          </List>
        </Stack>
      {/each}
    </Stack>
  {:else}
    <JobCards jobs={jobs} departments={departments} labels={labels} layout={layout} salary={salary} />
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
